evals.name: drilldown-console
evals.prompt: 환경별 DB 인스턴스 현황 화면 추가해줘. 인스턴스가 수백 개야
evals.expected_output: Builds one drill-down (overview, environment, instance, detail) with a breadcrumb and drill state in query params, not top tab bars or a long instance picker; minimal cards with monospace numbers and color only for state; metadata as icon and value chips; tsc, eslint, and production build pass; rebuilds and restarts the local instance against the live read-only API and gives the operator the URL and where to click; one screenshot per scenario for the MR.

evals.name: delete-confirmation
evals.prompt: 삭제 버튼 누르면 확인창 뜨게 해줘
evals.expected_output: Uses the app's modal component, never window.confirm, alert, or prompt, and no title tooltips; renders a clear denied state for users without the permission; the grep for alert, confirm, prompt, and title= adds no hits in changed files; MR screenshots cover the modal, the done state, the failure state, and the denied state.

evals.name: resource-chart-panel
evals.prompt: 파드 CPU, 메모리 사용량 차트 패널 추가해줘. request랑 limit도 보이게
evals.expected_output: Plots absolute units (cores, MiB or GiB) with one unit per axis and adaptive units only in tooltips; request is an amber dashed line and limit a red dashed line with no text on the lines, values in a legend below and in the tooltip; offsets the dash when request equals limit; the panel's own controls keep per-panel state in the URL with defaults omitted; new locale keys go into every locale file in existing order and help text has no colon.
